items.title: From neural development to regenerative medicine: A research journey in stem cell biology, spinal cord repair, and iPSC-based drug discovery.
items.summary: This commemorative article reflects on a research journey spanning neural development, stem cell biology, regenerative medicine, and iPSC-based drug discovery. My early work focused on RNA-mediated regulation in the nervous system, including studies on myelin basic protein gene regulation and the identification and functional characterization of the RNA-binding protein Musashi. These studies contributed to the conceptual foundation of neural stem cell biology and helped establish methods for identifying and isolating neural stem/progenitor cells, including those present in the adult human brain. Building on this foundation, my colleagues and I pursued translational research in spinal cord injury, ranging from analyses of injury pathophysiology and molecular interventions to preclinical studies using rodent and non-human primate models. These efforts ultimately led to the first-in-human clinical study of induced pluripotent stem cell-derived neural stem/progenitor cell transplantation for subacute spinal cord injury. In parallel, we developed patient-derived iPSC platforms for neurological disease modeling and drug discovery, particularly for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, where iPSC-based screening identified Ropinirole as a therapeutic candidate and enabled reverse translational research linking cellular phenotypes with clinical responses. Looking ahead, I argue that the future of regenerative therapy will depend on the continued integration of developmental biology, stem cell science, disease modeling, rehabilitation, and clinical translation to address unmet medical needs in disorders of the central nervous system.
items.titleZh: 从神经发育到再生医学：干细胞生物学、脊髓修复和基于iPSC的药物发现研究之旅
items.summaryZh: 本文是作者研究历程的回顾性综述，总结了从神经发育基础研究到再生医学转化的关键进展。核心内容包括：发现RNA结合蛋白Musashi在神经干细胞中的功能；建立神经干/祖细胞分离方法；开展脊髓损伤的临床前研究并推进至iPSC衍生细胞移植的首次人体试验；利用患者来源iPSC平台筛选出ALS治疗候选药物罗匹尼罗。文章强调未来再生治疗需要多学科整合。
items.insight: 该文章由领域内资深研究者撰写，系统梳理了从基础神经发育研究到iPSC临床转化的完整路径，特别是罗匹尼罗作为ALS候选药物的发现过程，为ALS研究者提供了药物筛选和反向转化研究的范例，值得关注其方法学启示。

aiRead.keyFinding: iPSC筛选确定罗匹尼罗为ALS治疗候选药物，并已进入临床试验阶段。
aiRead.limitation: 作为回顾性综述，未提供原始实验数据，且部分内容为作者个人观点。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注罗匹尼罗治疗ALS的临床试验结果，以及iPSC平台在其他神经退行性疾病中的应用。

items.abstractZh: 这篇纪念性文章回顾了涵盖神经发育、干细胞生物学、再生医学和基于iPSC的药物发现的研究历程。早期工作聚焦于神经系统中RNA介导的调控，包括髓鞘碱性蛋白基因调控研究，以及RNA结合蛋白Musashi的鉴定和功能表征。这些研究为神经干细胞生物学的概念基础做出了贡献，并帮助建立了识别和分离神经干/祖细胞（包括成人脑中的神经干/祖细胞）的方法。在此基础上，作者及其同事开展了脊髓损伤的转化研究，从损伤病理生理学分析和分子干预，到使用啮齿动物和非人灵长类模型的临床前研究。这些努力最终导致了诱导多能干细胞来源的神经干/祖细胞移植治疗亚急性脊髓损伤的首次人体临床研究。与此同时，他们开发了患者来源的iPSC平台，用于神经系统疾病建模和药物发现，特别是在肌萎缩侧索硬化症中，基于iPSC的筛选确定了罗匹尼罗作为治疗候选药物，并实现了将细胞表型与临床反应联系起来的反向转化研究。展望未来，作者认为再生治疗的未来将依赖于发育生物学、干细胞科学、疾病建模、康复和临床转化的持续整合，以解决中枢神经系统疾病中未满足的医疗需求。
items.frontierRationale: 该文章发表于2026年，总结了iPSC技术在ALS药物发现中的最新应用，具有明确的转化价值。

items.title: Sex-associated differences in routine inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: a retrospective cross-sectional study.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder with substantial clinical heterogeneity. Systemic inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements have both been studied in ALS, but their sex-associated differences within ALS cohorts remain incompletely characterized. To examine sex-associated differences in routine inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements in patients with ALS, and to determine whether these differences persisted after adjustment for available clinical and anthropometric variables. In this retrospective cross-sectional study, 135 patients with ALS were included. Routine inflammatory markers, including neutrophils, monocytes, lymphocytes, platelets, and erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR), were analyzed alongside quantitative neuromuscular ultrasound measurements. Between-sex comparisons were performed, and false discovery rate correction was applied to account for multiple testing. Multivariable linear regression analyses were performed with adjustment for age, disease duration, body mass index (BMI), ALSFRS-R total score, FVC% predicted, smoking status, hypertension, and diabetes. Female patients showed lower ALSFRS-R total scores and higher estimated progression rates in unadjusted comparisons, whereas pulmonary function variables did not differ significantly between sexes. After FDR correction, estimated progression rate, neutrophil count, monocyte count, ESR, and masseter muscle thickness remained significantly different between sexes, while the ALSFRS-R difference was borderline significant. In fully adjusted models, female sex was associated with lower neutrophil count, monocyte count, and median nerve cross-sectional area; biceps brachii thickness showed a less stable association after sensitivity analysis. An exploratory secondary analysis showed lower rectus femoris cross-sectional area during thigh-lift in female patients after full adjustment. In the spline sensitivity analysis, this association remained statistically significant but was interpreted cautiously because it was not present in the earlier adjustment models. Selected routine inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements differed between male and female patients within this ALS cohort. These findings support consideration of sex and anthropometric context, including body size, when interpreting inflammatory markers and ultrasound-based structural measurements. In the absence of healthy controls, the observed ultrasound differences cannot be attributed specifically to ALS-related biology. Studies with healthy controls, longitudinal functional outcomes, body-composition assessment, and independent multicenter cohorts are needed to clarify the disease-specific and prognostic relevance of these observations.

items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症中常规炎症标志物与神经肌肉超声测量的性别相关差异：一项回顾性横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 这项回顾性研究分析了135名ALS患者的常规血液炎症指标和神经肌肉超声数据，发现女性患者的中性粒细胞、单核细胞计数和ESR更低，咬肌厚度和正中神经横截面积也更小，且女性患者疾病进展率估计更高。研究提示，在解读ALS患者的炎症指标和超声测量结果时，应考虑性别和体型差异。
items.insight: 该研究系统性地揭示了ALS患者中炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声指标的性别差异，提示性别和体型是解读这些生物标志物时不可忽视的混杂因素，对未来ALS临床试验的入组分层和生物标志物验证具有重要参考价值。

aiRead.keyFinding: ALS女性患者表现出较低的炎症细胞计数（中性粒细胞、单核细胞）、ESR、咬肌厚度和正中神经横截面积，且估计疾病进展率更高。
aiRead.limitation: 缺乏健康对照组，无法区分观察到的超声差异是ALS特异性还是性别/体型固有差异；单中心回顾性设计，样本量有限。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种具有显著临床异质性的进行性神经退行性疾病。系统性炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量均已在ALS中有所研究，但ALS队列中这些指标的性别相关差异尚未被充分表征。本研究旨在检查ALS患者常规炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量的性别相关差异，并确定这些差异在调整可用的临床和人体测量变量后是否仍然存在。这项回顾性横断面研究纳入了135名ALS患者。分析了包括中性粒细胞、单核细胞、淋巴细胞、血小板和红细胞沉降率（ESR）在内的常规炎症标志物，以及定量神经肌肉超声测量。进行了性别间比较，并应用错误发现率（FDR）校正以处理多重检验。多变量线性回归分析调整了年龄、病程、体重指数（BMI）、ALSFRS-R总分、FVC%预计值、吸烟状况、高血压和糖尿病。在未调整的比较中，女性患者的ALSFRS-R总分较低，估计进展率较高，而肺功能变量在性别间无显著差异。经FDR校正后，估计进展率、中性粒细胞计数、单核细胞计数、ESR和咬肌厚度在性别间仍存在显著差异，而ALSFRS-R差异为临界显著。在完全调整的模型中，女性性别与较低的中性粒细胞计数、单核细胞计数和正中神经横截面积相关；肱二头肌厚度在敏感性分析后关联性不稳定。一项探索性二次分析显示，在完全调整后，女性患者抬腿时股直肌横截面积较低。在样条敏感性分析中，该关联仍具有统计学显著性，但因未在早期调整模型中出现而被谨慎解读。在该ALS队列中，选定的常规炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量在男性和女性患者间存在差异。这些发现支持在解读炎症标志物和超声结构测量时考虑性别和人体测量背景（包括体型）。由于缺乏健康对照组，观察到的超声差异不能明确归因于ALS相关生物学。需要包含健康对照、纵向功能结局、身体成分评估和独立多中心队列的研究来阐明这些观察结果的疾病特异性和预后相关性。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究聚焦于ALS临床异质性中常被忽视的性别维度，为精准解读炎症和超声生物标志物提供了新近的、具有转化价值的证据。

items.title: Pathology of general proprioception in a canine disease model of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Some forms of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) are associated with sequence variants in the superoxide dismutase 1 gene (SOD1). The mechanisms by which these variants contribute to ALS disease pathogenesis are poorly understood. Degenerative myelopathy (DM), a naturally occurring canine disease, shares similarities with some forms of SOD1-associated ALS, especially cases with sensory impairment. While motor pathway involvement in ALS has been extensively studied, sensory pathology has received comparatively less attention. To investigate whether pathology in the general proprioceptive pathway is associated with pelvic limb general proprioceptive ataxia, an early DM sign, we examined sensory system components of this pathway from Pembroke Welsh Corgis with early- and late-stage DM and age-matched controls. The disease was characterized by axonal pathology in the spinocerebellar tracts and the fasciculus gracilis, pronounced accumulation of SOD1-positive inclusions in nucleus thoracicus and dorsal root ganglia (DRG) neurons, and altered SOD1 immunolabeling in dorsal and ventral root axons and ensheathing myelin. Axonal pathology was also observed in a pelvic limb sensory nerve. These findings suggest that pathology in the proprioceptive sensory pathways may play a significant role in general proprioceptive ataxia in DM. Some dogs that were homozygous for the SOD1 risk allele did not develop clinical disease or the associated neuropathology, indicating that other factors in addition to the SOD1 mutation influence disease onset and progression.
items.evidenceLevel: 动物模型研究（犬类自然发生疾病模型）
items.titleZh: 犬肌萎缩侧索硬化疾病模型中一般本体感觉的病理学
items.summaryZh: 这项研究利用自然发生的犬退行性脊髓病（DM）作为SOD1相关ALS的模型，首次系统性地检查了一般本体感觉通路的病理变化。研究发现，在DM早期即出现共济失调症状时，脊髓小脑束、薄束、胸核和背根神经节中已存在显著的轴突病理和SOD1蛋白聚集。值得注意的是，部分携带SOD1风险基因纯合子的犬并未发病，提示存在其他修饰因素。该研究填补了ALS感觉系统病理研究的空白。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS的感觉系统受累提供了直接的病理学证据，提示本体感觉通路异常可能是疾病早期症状（如共济失调）的基础。对于关注SOD1相关ALS机制和寻找早期生物标志物的研究者，犬DM模型提供了一个独特且与人类疾病高度相关的转化研究平台。

aiRead.studyType: 病例对照组织病理学研究（犬类疾病模型）
aiRead.keyFinding: 在犬DM模型中，一般本体感觉通路（脊髓小脑束、薄束、胸核、DRG）出现显著轴突病理和SOD1阳性包涵体，且与早期共济失调症状相关；但SOD1风险纯合子并非完全外显。
aiRead.limitation: 研究为描述性病理学研究，样本量可能有限；犬DM与人类ALS的差异需注意；未阐明SOD1突变导致感觉神经元损伤的具体分子机制。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续研究是否在人类ALS患者感觉神经节或脊髓后索中验证类似病理，以及寻找影响SOD1突变外显率的修饰基因或环境因素。

items.abstractZh: 某些形式的肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）与超氧化物歧化酶1基因（SOD1）的序列变异相关。这些变异导致ALS疾病发病机制的机制尚不明确。退行性脊髓病（DM）是一种自然发生的犬类疾病，与某些形式的SOD1相关ALS（尤其是伴有感觉障碍的病例）具有相似性。虽然ALS中运动通路的受累已被广泛研究，但感觉病理学受到的关注相对较少。为了研究一般本体感觉通路中的病理是否与骨盆肢体一般本体感觉性共济失调（DM的早期体征）相关，我们检查了来自彭布罗克威尔士柯基犬（患有早期和晚期DM）及年龄匹配对照组的该通路的感觉系统组成部分。该疾病的特征包括脊髓小脑束和薄束中的轴突病理、胸核和背根神经节（DRG）神经元中SOD1阳性包涵体的显著积累，以及背根和腹根轴突及其包裹髓鞘中SOD1免疫标记的改变。在骨盆肢体感觉神经中也观察到轴突病理。这些发现表明，本体感觉通路中的病理可能在DM的一般本体感觉性共济失调中发挥重要作用。一些SOD1风险等位基因纯合子的犬并未发展出临床疾病或相关的神经病理学，表明除SOD1突变外，其他因素也影响疾病的发病和进展。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，聚焦于ALS中长期被忽视的感觉/本体感觉通路病理，利用与人类SOD1-ALS高度相似的犬类自然疾病模型，具有重要的转化医学价值。

items.title: When algorithms speak first: The public health risk of consumer AI in ALS diagnosis.
items.summary: Consumer AI platforms are increasingly used by patients to interpret medical reports, including ENMG results for ALS. While AI shows promise in controlled clinical settings (e.g., stroke imaging, melanoma detection), consumer-facing tools often provide overconfident, context-free diagnostic assertions (e.g., 'definitive evidence of ALS'), leading to premature and potentially harmful life-altering decisions. To highlight the clinical, ethical, and regulatory risks of unregulated AI in ALS diagnosis and propose actionable solutions. We present a case of AI-mediated misdiagnosis, analyze the limitations of consumer-facing AI (lack of clinical context, longitudinal data, and specialist oversight), and discuss the "authority paradox" (patients trusting AI outputs over clinicians' nuanced assessments). We propose a structured 4-step clinical approach for managing AI-mediated self-diagnoses and urge regulators to classify such tools as high-risk under the EU AI Act. The uncritical adoption of consumer AI in ALS diagnosis represents a public health risk. Clinicians, regulators, and developers must collaborate to ensure AI serves patients safely and ethically.
items.titleZh: 当算法先开口：消费级人工智能在ALS诊断中的公共卫生风险
items.summaryZh: 这篇观点文章警告，患者使用消费级AI工具解读肌电图等检查结果，可能因AI缺乏临床背景和专科监督而给出过度自信的错误诊断，导致ALS患者做出过早的、可能有害的决定。作者提出了一套4步临床应对流程，并呼吁将此类AI工具按欧盟AI法案列为高风险产品。
items.insight: 该文章提醒ALS研究者，AI在诊断辅助中的潜力与风险并存，尤其是消费级工具的无序使用可能干扰临床决策，推动对AI监管和临床整合策略的讨论。

aiRead.studyType: 观点/评论文章（含病例报告）
aiRead.keyFinding: 消费级AI在ALS诊断中可能提供过度自信的错误结论，导致误诊和不当决策，需加强监管和临床应对。
aiRead.limitation: 基于单一病例和文献分析，缺乏系统性数据支持。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注欧盟AI法案对医疗AI工具的具体分类及执行，以及临床指南对AI辅助诊断的更新。

items.abstractZh: 消费级AI平台越来越多地被患者用于解读医学报告，包括ALS的肌电图（ENMG）结果。尽管AI在受控临床环境中显示出潜力（如卒中影像、黑色素瘤检测），面向消费者的工具往往提供过度自信、缺乏背景的诊断断言（例如“ALS的明确证据”），导致过早且可能有害的重大决策。为强调无监管AI在ALS诊断中的临床、伦理和监管风险，并提出可行的解决方案，我们报告了一例AI介导的误诊案例，分析了消费级AI的局限性（缺乏临床背景、纵向数据和专科医生监督），并讨论了“权威悖论”（患者信任AI输出胜过临床医生的细致评估）。我们提出了一种结构化的4步临床方法来管理AI介导的自我诊断，并敦促监管机构根据欧盟AI法案将此类工具归类为高风险。在ALS诊断中不加批判地采用消费级AI构成公共卫生风险。临床医生、监管机构和开发者必须合作，确保AI安全、合乎伦理地为患者服务。
items.frontierRationale: 该文章聚焦于2026年新近出现的消费级AI在ALS诊断中的应用风险，具有直接的临床转化和监管相关性。

items.title: Tofersen Treatment in SOD1 -ALS: Real-World Evidence from a Retrospective Multicenter Study in France (FORSLA Study).
items.summary: To evaluate the effectiveness of Tofersen in patients with superoxide dismutase 1 gene ( SOD1-ALS ) patients in France in a real-world setting, using disease progression within patient comparisons and with a historical cohort. Patients with SOD1 -ALS were included from across 19 French FILSLAN network centers. Baseline was defined as the treatment initiation date. Main endpoints were the ALSFRS-R progression rate and plasmatic neurofilament light chain (NfL) levels at baseline and 12 months after baseline. In the Tofersen Cohort (N=46), within-group comparisons showed that the mean ALS functional rating scale revised (ALSFRS-R) progression rate slowed from 0.53 ± 0.5 at baseline to 0.22 ± 0.3 point/month at 12 months ( P =.006). NfL levels significantly decreased from 89.0 ± 9.0 pg/ml at baseline to 29.2 ± 19.5.5 at 12 months ( P =.004). Exploratory comparisons with a propensity score (PS) matched historical cohort (39 matched pairs) using a mixed-effects model, ALSFRS-R progression rate at baseline, 6 months, and 12 months after baseline, showed no statistically significant differences between groups P =.30, whereas longitudinal ALSFRS-R scores differed significantly between groups (time-treatment interaction P =.006). The mean survival of the PS matched population was longer in the Tofersen Cohort (42.6 months) than the Historical Cohort (31.8 months) P =.004. Time-dependent adjusted cox analysis showed that Tofersen was associated with a reduction in mortality risk (adjusted HR=0.34; 95% CI, 0.12-0.91; P =.03). Tofersen seems to be associated with slower functional decline and reduced NfL levels. While limitations of retrospective design and ALSFRS-R sensitivity must be acknowledged, these findings provide real-world evidence suggesting a clinical benefit of Tofersen.
items.evidenceLevel: 观察性临床研究（多中心回顾性队列，含倾向评分匹配历史对照）
items.titleZh: Tofersen治疗SOD1-ALS：法国多中心回顾性研究的真实世界证据（FORSLA研究）
items.summaryZh: 法国19个中心46例SOD1-ALS患者的真实世界数据显示，接受Tofersen治疗12个月后，功能衰退速度（ALSFRS-R）减缓约58%，血浆NfL水平下降约67%。与历史匹配队列相比，Tofersen组中位生存期延长约11个月，死亡风险降低66%。研究为观察性证据，存在回顾性设计固有局限。
items.insight: 这是SOD1-ALS靶向治疗领域规模较大的真实世界研究之一，在随机对照试验之外提供了Tofersen在法国临床实践中的有效性证据，其生存获益信号尤其值得关注，可能影响SOD1-ALS患者的治疗决策和医保覆盖。

aiRead.studyType: 多中心回顾性真实世界研究（含倾向评分匹配历史对照）
aiRead.keyFinding: Tofersen治疗12个月显著减缓SOD1-ALS患者功能衰退（ALSFRS-R进展率从0.53降至0.22点/月）并降低NfL水平（89.0降至29.2 pg/ml），且与历史队列相比死亡风险降低66%（HR=0.34）。
aiRead.limitation: 回顾性设计、样本量较小（N=46）、ALSFRS-R对功能变化敏感性有限、历史对照可能存在未测量的混杂因素。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注Tofersen长期（>12个月）疗效和安全性数据、对生存期的进一步验证、以及其在症状前SOD1携带者中的预防性治疗研究结果。

items.abstractZh: 本研究旨在评估Tofersen在法国真实世界环境中对超氧化物歧化酶1基因（SOD1-ALS）患者的疗效，采用患者内疾病进展比较及与历史队列的比较方法。研究纳入来自法国19个FILSLAN网络中心的SOD1-ALS患者。基线定义为治疗开始日期。主要终点为基线和基线后12个月的ALSFRS-R进展率和血浆神经丝轻链（NfL）水平。在Tofersen队列（N=46）中，组内比较显示，平均ALSFRS-R进展率从基线的0.53±0.5点/月减缓至12个月时的0.22±0.3点/月（P=.006）。NfL水平从基线的89.0±9.0 pg/ml显著下降至12个月时的29.2±19.5 pg/ml（P=.004）。与倾向评分匹配的历史队列（39对匹配）的探索性比较（使用混合效应模型）显示，基线、6个月和12个月后的ALSFRS-R进展率组间无统计学显著差异（P=.30），而纵向ALSFRS-R评分组间差异显著（时间-治疗交互作用P=.006）。倾向评分匹配人群的平均生存期在Tofersen队列（42.6个月）长于历史队列（31.8个月）（P=.004）。时间依赖性校正Cox分析显示，Tofersen与死亡风险降低相关（校正HR=0.34；95% CI，0.12-0.91；P=.03）。Tofersen似乎与较慢的功能衰退和NfL水平降低相关。尽管必须承认回顾性设计和ALSFRS-R敏感性的局限性，但这些发现提供了提示Tofersen临床获益的真实世界证据。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，提供了Tofersen（首个获批的SOD1-ALS反义寡核苷酸疗法）在真实世界中的最新疗效和生存数据，具有直接的ALS临床转化价值。

items.title: Gut microbiota and brain health: Disease-specific pathways and emerging therapeutic strategies.
items.summary: The microbiota-gut-brain axis (MGBA) has emerged as a dynamic, bidirectional communication system linking the gastrointestinal tract and the central nervous system (CNS) through neural, immune, endocrine, and metabolic mechanisms. Increasing evidence indicates that alterations in gut microbial communities are associated with a wide range of neurological disorders; however, the strength of this association varies across diseases, and many mechanistic observations still rely predominantly on experimental models rather than human studies. This review provides an overview of current evidence regarding the role of the gut microbiota in maintaining CNS homeostasis, with particular emphasis on intestinal barrier function, immune modulation, vagal and enteric communication, and the generation of biologically active microbial metabolites, including short-chain fatty acids, bile acids, and neurotransmitter-related compounds. Studies in both clinical and experimental settings have reported disease-specific microbial signatures in conditions such as Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, multiple sclerosis, autism spectrum disorders, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. In parallel, microbiota-directed interventions-including probiotics, prebiotics, dietary approaches, fecal microbiota transplantation, and strategies targeting microbial metabolites-have produced encouraging findings in preclinical studies and early-stage clinical investigations. Nevertheless, considerable heterogeneity in study populations, experimental methodologies, and therapeutic protocols continues to limit the translation of these findings into routine clinical practice. Collectively, current evidence supports the MGBA as a valuable framework for understanding neurological diseases while underscoring the need for rigorously designed longitudinal studies and well-controlled clinical trials to define its therapeutic relevance better.

items.titleZh: 肠道微生物群与大脑健康：疾病特异性通路与新兴治疗策略
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述系统梳理了肠道微生物群通过肠-脑轴影响中枢神经系统健康的证据，涵盖屏障功能、免疫调节、神经通讯和代谢产物等机制。文章指出，在ALS等多种神经退行性疾病中已观察到疾病特异性的肠道菌群特征，但多数机制证据仍来自动物模型。针对菌群的干预策略（如益生菌、粪菌移植）在早期研究中显示出潜力，但研究异质性大，距离临床应用尚有距离。
items.insight: 该综述将ALS置于肠-脑轴研究框架中，提示肠道菌群特征可能成为ALS的疾病标志物或治疗靶点。对于ALS研究者而言，文中汇总的疾病特异性菌群特征和干预策略为设计纵向队列研究或探索菌群调节辅助治疗提供了背景依据。

aiRead.keyFinding: 肠道菌群改变与ALS等多种神经疾病相关，存在疾病特异性菌群特征；菌群靶向干预在临床前和早期临床研究中显示前景，但证据尚不充分。
aiRead.limitation: 综述未提供原始数据；所引用的机制证据多来自实验模型而非人类研究；各研究间方法学和人群异质性大。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注针对ALS患者的前瞻性纵向菌群队列研究，以及益生菌或代谢产物干预在ALS中的随机对照试验结果。

items.abstractZh: 微生物群-肠-脑轴（MGBA）已成为一个动态的双向通讯系统，通过神经、免疫、内分泌和代谢机制将胃肠道与中枢神经系统（CNS）联系起来。越来越多的证据表明，肠道微生物群落的改变与多种神经系统疾病相关；然而，这种关联的强度因疾病而异，且许多机制性观察仍主要依赖于实验模型而非人类研究。本综述概述了关于肠道微生物群在维持CNS稳态中作用的现有证据，特别强调肠道屏障功能、免疫调节、迷走神经和肠神经系统通讯，以及具有生物活性的微生物代谢产物（包括短链脂肪酸、胆汁酸和神经递质相关化合物）的产生。临床和实验环境中的研究报告了阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、多发性硬化症、自闭症谱系障碍和肌萎缩侧索硬化等疾病中疾病特异性的微生物特征。与此同时，针对微生物群的干预措施——包括益生菌、益生元、饮食方法、粪菌移植和针对微生物代谢产物的策略——在临床前研究和早期临床研究中产生了令人鼓舞的结果。然而，研究人群、实验方法和治疗方案中的显著异质性继续限制着这些发现向常规临床实践的转化。总的来说，现有证据支持MGBA作为理解神经系统疾病的一个有价值的框架，同时强调需要严格设计的纵向研究和良好对照的临床试验，以更好地确定其治疗相关性。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述发表于2026年，整合了肠-脑轴在ALS等神经退行性疾病中的最新机制证据与新兴菌群干预策略，具有明确的ALS转化研究价值。

items.title: Macrophage responses to and elevated antibody levels against Chlorovirus ATCV-1 in ALS patients.
items.summary: Acanthocystis turfacea chlorella virus 1 (ATCV-1) is a giant virus that is part of the human oral microvirome. Previously we showed that ATCV-1 infects mouse macrophages, stimulates production of inflammatory cytokines, and accelerates motor neuron disease in the Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) model SOD1-G93A transgenic mice. This, coupled with significantly elevated levels of serum IgG1 antibody to ATCV-1 in ALS patients compared with healthy controls, suggests involvement of ATCV-1 in ALS. Herein, using serum and CSF from a different ALS cohort we again show elevated antibodies to ATCV-1 in ALS patients compared with healthy controls. To assess ATCV-1 in human macrophages, we challenged immature (IMM), M0, M1, and M2 human THP-1 macrophage cells containing an Interferon Stimulated Response Element (ISRE) promoter-reporter with ATCV-1 or its Major Capsid protein (MCP) glycans. ATCV-1 infected M1 THP-1 to a greater degree than IMM, M0, or M2 THP-1. The initial high ISRE-promoter activity of M1 THP-1 was suppressed by the MCP-Glycans of ATCV-1. M0, but not IMM or M2 THP-1 produced IL-6 in response to ATCV-1 or its MCP-glycan, while high levels of IL-6 from unchallenged M1 THP-1 increased further by ATCV-1 or its MCP glycan. In contrast, ATCV-1 or its MCP-Glycan significantly reduced the high levels of IL-10 produced by M2 THP-1. Thus, antibody to ATCV-1 in ALS patients and the susceptibility of human M1 macrophages to ATCV-1 infection with boosted inflammatory cytokine and diminished anti-inflammatory cytokine production suggest that ATCV-1 may contribute to ALS motor neuron disease.
items.titleZh: ALS患者巨噬细胞对Chlorovirus ATCV-1的反应及抗体水平升高
items.summaryZh: 这项研究发现，ALS患者体内针对绿藻病毒ATCV-1的抗体水平高于健康人，且该病毒能感染人M1型巨噬细胞，增强炎症反应并抑制抗炎反应，提示ATCV-1可能参与ALS的病理过程。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS的环境/感染因素假说提供了新证据，将口腔微生物组中的病毒与巨噬细胞免疫失调联系起来，可能为ALS的发病机制和潜在治疗靶点提供新方向。

aiRead.studyType: 观察性临床研究结合体外细胞实验
aiRead.keyFinding: ALS患者血清和脑脊液中抗ATCV-1抗体水平升高；ATCV-1优先感染M1巨噬细胞，增强IL-6产生并降低IL-10产生。
aiRead.limitation: 研究为关联性发现，未直接证明ATCV-1导致ALS；体外实验使用THP-1细胞系，可能不能完全代表原代人巨噬细胞。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续研究是否在更大ALS队列中验证抗体水平，以及ATCV-1感染是否在动物模型中直接影响运动神经元损伤。

items.abstractZh: Acanthocystis turfacea chlorella virus 1 (ATCV-1) 是一种巨型病毒，属于人类口腔微生物组的一部分。此前研究表明，ATCV-1可感染小鼠巨噬细胞，刺激炎症细胞因子产生，并加速肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）模型SOD1-G93A转基因小鼠的运动神经元疾病进展。此外，与健康对照相比，ALS患者血清中针对ATCV-1的IgG1抗体水平显著升高，提示ATCV-1可能参与ALS发病。本研究使用来自不同ALS队列的血清和脑脊液，再次证实ALS患者中针对ATCV-1的抗体水平高于健康对照。为评估ATCV-1对人巨噬细胞的作用，研究者使用含有干扰素刺激反应元件（ISRE）启动子报告基因的未成熟（IMM）、M0、M1和M2人THP-1巨噬细胞，分别用ATCV-1或其主要衣壳蛋白（MCP）聚糖进行刺激。结果显示，ATCV-1对M1 THP-1的感染程度高于IMM、M0或M2 THP-1。M1 THP-1初始较高的ISRE启动子活性被ATCV-1的MCP聚糖抑制。M0（而非IMM或M2）THP-1在ATCV-1或其MCP聚糖刺激下产生IL-6，而未受刺激的M1 THP-1本身高水平的IL-6在ATCV-1或其MCP聚糖作用下进一步增加。相反，ATCV-1或其MCP聚糖显著降低了M2 THP-1产生的高水平IL-10。因此，ALS患者中针对ATCV-1的抗体以及人M1巨噬细胞对ATCV-1感染的易感性（伴随炎症细胞因子增强和抗炎细胞因子减少）提示ATCV-1可能促进ALS运动神经元疾病进展。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究结合了临床样本（ALS患者抗体水平）和体外巨噬细胞实验，揭示了ATCV-1感染与ALS免疫失调的关联，具有转化价值，且发表于2026年，具有新近性。

items.title: Multiplex Panel Detects Glial and Inflammatory Biomarker Signatures in Sporadic and C9orf72-ALS.
items.summary: CSF proteomics has emerged as a valuable strategy for identifying diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). However, the limited availability and volumes of CSF samples restrict the broader clinical application of CSF-based biomarker panels. To address this challenge, we investigated whether the novel nucleic acid-linked immuno-sandwich assay (NULISA) multiplex platform-capable of quantifying multiple neural, glial, and inflammatory markers from minimal biofluid volumes-could validate previously proposed biomarkers and identify additional candidates relevant to ALS. Using this platform, we measured a targeted panel of 131 biomarkers in cohorts of patients with C9orf72-associated ALS, sporadic ALS (sALS), and matched healthy controls. The 6 markers neurofilament heavy chain (NEFH) and neurofilament light chain (NEFL), chitinases-particularly chitotriosidase-1 (CHIT1) and chitinase-3-like protein-1 (CHI3L1), and chemokines CCL2 and CCL3 were significantly elevated in both ALS groups compared with controls. These biomarkers correlated with disease progression and demonstrated strong diagnostic performance when combined into aggregate scores, as reflected by a high area under the receiver operating characteristic curve for ALS. Notably, C9orf72-ALS patients exhibited higher levels of the oxidative stress-related markers PRDX6 and ENO2, compared with sALS patients, suggesting a genotype-specific molecular signature. Overall, our findings support the use of a multiplexed panel of diverse, inflammatory, glial, and neurodegeneration-associated biomarkers as a complementary diagnostic and prognostic tool alongside established measurements of neurofilaments. This approach may enhance biomarker robustness while minimizing CSF volume requirements, thereby improving clinical feasibility in ALS research and care.
items.titleZh: 多重检测面板在散发性ALS和C9orf72-ALS中检测到胶质细胞和炎症生物标志物特征
items.summaryZh: 这项研究利用NULISA多重平台，在少量脑脊液中同时检测131种生物标志物，发现NEFL、NEFH、CHIT1、CHI3L1、CCL2和CCL3在ALS患者中显著升高，且与疾病进展相关。C9orf72-ALS患者还表现出独特的氧化应激标志物（PRDX6、ENO2）升高。该面板有望成为ALS诊断和预后的补充工具，减少脑脊液用量。
items.insight: 该研究首次在少量脑脊液样本中验证了多种ALS生物标志物的组合诊断价值，并揭示了C9orf72基因型特异的分子特征，为ALS的精准分型和个体化治疗监测提供了新思路。

aiRead.studyType: 观察性临床研究（生物标志物验证）
aiRead.keyFinding: NULISA平台可检测到ALS患者脑脊液中6种显著升高的生物标志物（NEFL、NEFH、CHIT1、CHI3L1、CCL2、CCL3），且C9orf72-ALS患者有独特的氧化应激标志物升高。
aiRead.limitation: 样本量可能有限，且未提供具体队列规模；未进行纵向随访以验证预后价值；结果需在更大独立队列中验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注该多重面板在更大ALS队列中的验证，以及其与疾病进展和生存期的关联；同时关注C9orf72特异性标志物（PRDX6、ENO2）的机制研究。

items.abstractZh: 脑脊液蛋白质组学已成为识别肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）诊断和预后生物标志物的重要策略。然而，脑脊液样本的有限可用性和体积限制了基于脑脊液的生物标志物面板的更广泛临床应用。为应对这一挑战，我们研究了新型核酸连接免疫夹心测定（NULISA）多重平台——该平台能够从极少量生物流体中定量多种神经、胶质和炎症标志物——是否能够验证先前提出的生物标志物并识别与ALS相关的其他候选标志物。使用该平台，我们在C9orf72相关ALS、散发性ALS（sALS）和匹配的健康对照队列中测量了131种生物标志物的靶向面板。与对照组相比，两个ALS组中6种标志物显著升高：神经丝重链（NEFH）和神经丝轻链（NEFL）、几丁质酶——特别是壳三糖苷酶-1（CHIT1）和几丁质酶-3样蛋白-1（CHI3L1），以及趋化因子CCL2和CCL3。这些生物标志物与疾病进展相关，并在组合成综合评分时表现出强大的诊断性能，如ALS的受试者工作特征曲线下面积较高所示。值得注意的是，与sALS患者相比，C9orf72-ALS患者表现出更高水平的氧化应激相关标志物PRDX6和ENO2，提示存在基因型特异性分子特征。总体而言，我们的研究结果支持使用包含多种炎症、胶质和神经退行性相关生物标志物的多重面板，作为已建立的神经丝测量的补充诊断和预后工具。这种方法可能增强生物标志物的稳健性，同时最小化脑脊液体积需求，从而提高ALS研究和护理中的临床可行性。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究利用新型NULISA多重平台，在极少量脑脊液中同时检测多种生物标志物，并发现基因型特异特征，具有转化价值，可能推动ALS液体活检的临床应用。

items.title: Association of Military Branch and Rank With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Incidence Among United States Veterans.
items.summary: Military service is one of the most consistent risk factors for the development of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), but little is known about what aspects of military service matter. Understanding the distribution of ALS risk in military personnel may help identify key risk factors. We aimed to ascertain the association of United States (US) military branch and rank with incident ALS. We conducted a longitudinal cohort study including all veterans with a Veterans Health Administration encounter from January 1, 2000, through October 1, 2024, and more than 2 years of follow-up. Incident ALS was identified through medical records. Exposures included military branch (Army, Navy, Air Force, Marine Corps, Coast Guard, or multiple branches), military rank (officer, enlisted, or both), and length of service. Risk was estimated with Cox proportional hazards models, controlled for age, adjusted for race/ethnicity, and stratified by sex. The analytic sample comprised 9,157,938 men (13,935 incident ALS cases, mean age = 56.9 years) and 784,941 women (484 cases, mean age = 42.4 at start of follow up). Among men, compared with service in the Army, service in the Air Force (hazard ratio [HR] = 1.29, 95% CI 1.23-1.35), Navy (HR = 1.15, 95% CI 1.10-1.20), and Coast Guard (HR = 1.26, 95% CI 1.06-1.50) was associated with higher rates of ALS and service in the Marines a lower rate (HR = 0.78, 95% CI 0.68-0.88). Officers had higher rates than enlisted personnel (men, HR = 1.64, 95% CI 1.53-1.74; women, HR = 1.72, 95% CI 1.31-2.27). Longer service was associated with lower rates of ALS. In age-stratified models, differences in hazard rates between Army veterans and Air Force, Navy, and Coast Guard veterans were greatest for the youngest men (17-61 years, HR range = 1.26 to 1.51) and smallest for the oldest (>75-104 years, HR range = 0.99 to 1.12). ALS rates varied considerably by branch and rank in the US military, with larger differences among younger veterans. Officers and those serving in the Air Force, Navy, or Coast Guard may incur exposure to military environments that increase risk of ALS. It is imperative to identify relevant exposures to reduce harm to service members and, potentially, civilians with similar exposures.
items.titleZh: 美国退伍军人中军种和军衔与肌萎缩侧索硬化症发病率的关联
items.summaryZh: 这项大型队列研究分析了美国退伍军人中军种、军衔与ALS发病率的关系。研究发现，空军、海军和海岸警卫队服役的男性ALS风险高于陆军，而海军陆战队风险较低；军官风险高于士兵；服役年限越长风险越低。这些差异在年轻退伍军人中更为明显。研究提示特定军事环境暴露可能增加ALS风险，但具体暴露因素尚待识别。
items.insight: 该研究是迄今规模最大的关于军事服役特征与ALS风险的队列研究之一，覆盖超过900万退伍军人，明确了军种和军衔对ALS风险的影响，为识别可干预的军事环境暴露提供了关键线索，对ALS病因学研究具有重要价值。

aiRead.keyFinding: 空军、海军和海岸警卫队服役及军官身份与较高的ALS发病率相关，且年轻退伍军人中差异更显著。
aiRead.limitation: 观察性设计无法确定因果关系；未纳入具体暴露因素（如化学物质、创伤等）；退伍军人健康管理局数据可能未覆盖所有退伍军人。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续研究应聚焦于识别军种和军衔相关的具体暴露因素（如职业环境、训练强度、疫苗接种等），并探索其与ALS发病的生物学机制。

items.abstractZh: 军事服役是肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）最一致的风险因素之一，但关于军事服役的哪些方面重要，目前知之甚少。了解军人中ALS风险的分布可能有助于识别关键风险因素。我们旨在确定美国（US）军种和军衔与ALS发病率的关联。我们进行了一项纵向队列研究，包括2000年1月1日至2024年10月1日期间所有在退伍军人健康管理局有就诊记录且随访超过2年的退伍军人。通过医疗记录识别新发ALS。暴露因素包括军种（陆军、海军、空军、海军陆战队、海岸警卫队或多个军种）、军衔（军官、士兵或两者）以及服役年限。使用Cox比例风险模型估计风险，控制年龄，调整种族/民族，并按性别分层。分析样本包括9,157,938名男性（13,935例新发ALS，平均年龄56.9岁）和784,941名女性（484例，随访开始时平均年龄42.4岁）。在男性中，与陆军服役相比，空军（风险比[HR]=1.29，95% CI 1.23-1.35）、海军（HR=1.15，95% CI 1.10-1.20）和海岸警卫队（HR=1.26，95% CI 1.06-1.50）服役与更高的ALS发病率相关，而海军陆战队服役与较低发病率相关（HR=0.78，95% CI 0.68-0.88）。军官的发病率高于士兵（男性，HR=1.64，95% CI 1.53-1.74；女性，HR=1.72，95% CI 1.31-2.27）。较长的服役年限与较低的ALS发病率相关。在年龄分层模型中，陆军退伍军人与空军、海军和海岸警卫队退伍军人之间的风险差异在年轻男性（17-61岁，HR范围=1.26至1.51）中最大，在老年男性（>75-104岁，HR范围=0.99至1.12）中最小。美国军队中ALS发病率因军种和军衔而有显著差异，年轻退伍军人中的差异更大。军官以及在空军、海军或海岸警卫队服役的人员可能暴露于增加ALS风险的军事环境中。识别相关暴露以减少对服役人员以及可能具有类似暴露的平民的伤害至关重要。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2024年最新随访数据，首次系统揭示军种和军衔对ALS风险的差异化影响，具有高度的ALS病因学转化价值。

items.title: Mapping the Synaptome in Neurodegeneration: Emerging Clinical Applications of SV2A PET Imaging.
items.summary: Synaptic loss is a core pathological feature of neurodegenerative disorders and closely relates to cognitive and functional decline. Positron emission tomography (PET) targeting synaptic vesicle glycoprotein 2A (SV2A) has recently emerged as a promising tool for the indirect assessment of presynaptic alterations in the living human brain. This leading article discusses the evolving clinical landscape of SV2A PET across the neurodegenerative spectrum, emphasizing its translational trajectory and emerging applications. Current evidence spans Alzheimer's disease (AD), other dementias, movement disorders, Huntington's disease (HD), and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). The literature is currently dominated by PET with [ 11 C]UCB-J, while [ 18 F]-labeled tracers, particularly [ 18 F]SynVesT-1, are expanding clinical feasibility through longer half-life and broader distribution potential. Across disorders, PET consistently detected SV2A reductions that frequently correlated with cognition, disease severity, and complementary biomarkers, including amyloid, tau, glucose metabolism, and dopaminergic imaging. Although the field remains limited by small cohorts, heterogeneous quantification strategies, and incomplete longitudinal validation, SV2A PET is rapidly evolving into a promising translational tool for studying synaptopathies and monitoring disease progression.
items.titleZh: 神经退行性疾病中的突触组图谱：SV2A PET成像的新兴临床应用
items.summaryZh: SV2A PET成像可在活体人脑中无创评估突触前改变，是神经退行性疾病（包括ALS）中很有潜力的突触丢失生物标志物。现有证据显示SV2A减少与认知和疾病严重程度相关，但研究仍以小样本为主，量化方法和纵向验证尚不完善。
items.insight: 对ALS研究者而言，SV2A PET提供了一种在活体中直接追踪突触丢失的手段，有望成为连接临床表型与病理机制的转化性生物标志物，值得关注其在ALS队列中的验证进展。

aiRead.studyType: 综述性重点文章（Leading article），基于观察性临床研究证据
aiRead.keyFinding: SV2A PET在多种神经退行性疾病中一致检测到突触前SV2A减少，且与认知、疾病严重程度及互补生物标志物相关；[18F]标记示踪剂正扩展其临床可行性。
aiRead.limitation: 现有研究样本量小、量化策略异质、纵向验证不完整，且文献以[11C]UCB-J为主，[18F]示踪剂数据仍有限。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注SV2A PET在ALS中的前瞻性纵向研究，以及[18F]SynVesT-1等新型示踪剂在更大队列中的验证结果。

items.abstractZh: 突触丢失是神经退行性疾病的核心病理特征，与认知和功能衰退密切相关。靶向突触囊泡糖蛋白2A（SV2A）的正电子发射断层扫描（PET）近期已成为在活体人脑中间接评估突触前改变的有前景工具。这篇重点文章讨论了SV2A PET在神经退行性疾病谱系中不断演变的临床格局，强调其转化轨迹和新兴应用。当前证据涵盖阿尔茨海默病（AD）、其他痴呆、运动障碍、亨廷顿病（HD）和肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）。文献目前以[11C]UCB-J PET为主，而[18F]标记示踪剂，特别是[18F]SynVesT-1，通过更长的半衰期和更广泛的分布潜力扩展了临床可行性。在各种疾病中，PET一致检测到SV2A减少，且常与认知、疾病严重程度及互补生物标志物（包括淀粉样蛋白、tau、葡萄糖代谢和多巴胺能成像）相关。尽管该领域仍受限于小样本队列、异质性量化策略和不完整的纵向验证，SV2A PET正迅速演变为研究突触病和监测疾病进展的有前景转化工具。
items.frontierRationale: 该文发表于2026年，系统梳理了SV2A PET在ALS等多种神经退行性疾病中的最新临床证据，具有明确的ALS生物标志物转化价值。

items.title: Clinical and genetic characteristics of 536 young-onset amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in China: a single-center retrospective study.
items.summary: Objective: Young-onset amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), defined as symptom onset at or before 45 years, remains poorly characterized in Chinese patients. We aimed to describe its clinical and genetic features and compare them with adult-onset ALS. Methods: We retrospectively analyzed 536 young-onset ALS patients registered at Peking Union Medical College Hospital (2014-2022) alongside 1136 adult-onset patients (onset >45 years). Whole exome sequencing targeting 41 established ALS-related genes was performed in all young-onset patients. Results: Young-onset ALS accounted for 32.0% of the cohort, with a median onset age of 39.5 years (IQR 34.25-44.0). Compared with adult-onset patients, young-onset cases had less bulbar onset (14.2% vs. 19.5%, p = 0.008), more frequent predominant upper motor neuron phenotype (25.9% vs. 15.4%, p < 0.001), higher baseline ALSFRS-R scores ( p < 0.001), slower progression ( p = 0.001), and longer median survival (36 vs. 30 months, p = 0.009). Familial ALS was more common in the young-onset group (8.4% vs. 3.8%, p < 0.001). Rare variants were identified in 20.0% of young-onset patients across 32 genes; pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants were predominantly in SOD1 and FUS . Compared with adult-onset patients, SOD1 was proportionally more common in adult-onset disease, whereas FUS variants were markedly enriched among young-onset cases, suggesting age-dependent differences in genetic architecture. Conclusion: Young-onset ALS in China is characterized by a slower clinical course and a distinct genetic profile dominated by SOD1 and FUS , with near-absent C9orf72 expansions. Routine genetic testing and age-stratified trial design are warranted in this population.
items.titleZh: 中国536例青年起病肌萎缩侧索硬化的临床与遗传特征：单中心回顾性研究
items.summaryZh: 这项来自北京协和医院的大型单中心研究显示，中国青年起病ALS（≤45岁）占全部ALS的32%，其临床病程较成年起病更缓慢、生存期更长，且遗传谱以SOD1和FUS变异为主，C9orf72扩增罕见。青年起病组中FUS变异显著富集，提示不同年龄段ALS的遗传基础存在差异。
items.insight: 该研究提供了中国人群青年起病ALS的最大样本临床与遗传数据，明确了FUS在青年起病中的富集和C9orf72的缺失，对指导基因检测策略和年龄分层临床试验设计具有直接参考价值。

aiRead.studyType: 单中心回顾性队列研究
aiRead.keyFinding: 中国青年起病ALS占32%，临床进展较慢，遗传上以SOD1和FUS为主，FUS变异在青年起病中显著富集，C9orf72扩增几乎缺失。
aiRead.limitation: 单中心设计可能引入选择偏倚；未对成年起病组进行全外显子测序，遗传比较可能不完全；回顾性数据可能影响生存期评估。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续应关注青年起病ALS中FUS变异的致病机制及潜在靶向治疗，并开展多中心前瞻性研究验证年龄分层遗传差异。

items.abstractZh: 目的：青年起病肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS），定义为症状起始年龄≤45岁，在中国患者中特征尚不明确。本研究旨在描述其临床和遗传特征，并与成年起病ALS进行比较。方法：我们回顾性分析了北京协和医院2014-2022年登记的536例青年起病ALS患者，以及1136例成年起病患者（起病年龄>45岁）。对所有青年起病患者进行了针对41个已知ALS相关基因的全外显子测序。结果：青年起病ALS占队列的32.0%，中位起病年龄为39.5岁（IQR 34.25-44.0）。与成年起病患者相比，青年起病病例球部起病比例较低（14.2% vs. 19.5%，p = 0.008），上运动神经元为主表型更常见（25.9% vs. 15.4%，p < 0.001），基线ALSFRS-R评分更高（p < 0.001），进展更慢（p = 0.001），中位生存期更长（36 vs. 30个月，p = 0.009）。家族性ALS在青年起病组中更常见（8.4% vs. 3.8%，p < 0.001）。在32个基因中，20.0%的青年起病患者检出罕见变异；致病或可能致病变异主要位于SOD1和FUS。与成年起病患者相比，SOD1在成年起病中比例更高，而FUS变异在青年起病病例中显著富集，提示遗传结构的年龄依赖性差异。结论：中国青年起病ALS以较缓慢的临床病程和以SOD1及FUS为主的独特遗传特征为特点，C9orf72扩增几乎缺失。建议对该人群进行常规基因检测和按年龄分层的试验设计。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2026年发表的最新数据，揭示了中国青年起病ALS独特的遗传架构（FUS富集、C9orf72缺失），为年龄分层精准诊疗提供了新依据。

items.title: Myokines, Microbiota, and Neuroinflammation: Physical Activity Modulates the Gut-Brain Axis.
items.summary: Neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis are increasingly recognized as disorders influenced not only by intrinsic neural pathology but also by systemic physiological networks, including the gut-brain axis. Emerging evidence highlights physical activity as a potent modulator of this bidirectional communication system, with muscle-derived signals particularly myokines, metabolites, and extracellular vesicles playing a central role. This narrative review synthesizes current knowledge on how exercise-induced molecular mediators influence gut microbiota composition, intestinal barrier integrity, immune signaling, and neuroinflammatory pathways. Findings were integrated across the disciplines of neuroscience, microbiology, and exercise physiology to evaluate mechanistic links between muscle-secreted factors and gut-mediated responses. Mechanistic links exist between muscle-secreted factors such as irisin, cathepsin B, BDNF-inducing pathways, and lactate with microbial metabolites including short-chain fatty acids. These interacting pathways demonstrate a combined impact on neuroprotection, synaptic plasticity, and the modulation of disease progression in neurodegenerative conditions. Physical activity represents a promising non-pharmacological strategy for modulating the gut-brain axis in neurodegenerative conditions. Understanding the interplay between muscle-derived signals and gut-mediated pathways may open new avenues for targeted interventions aimed at slowing or preventing neurodegenerative decline.
items.titleZh: 肌因子、微生物群与神经炎症：体力活动调节肠-脑轴
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述总结了运动如何通过肌肉分泌的肌因子（如鸢尾素、组织蛋白酶B、乳酸）影响肠道微生物群和神经炎症，进而调节肠-脑轴。在ALS等神经退行性疾病中，运动可能通过改善肠道屏障、调节免疫信号和神经炎症来发挥保护作用。但这是综述性证据，尚需更多机制和临床研究验证。
items.insight: 该综述为ALS研究者提供了运动调节肠-脑轴的新视角，提示肌因子-微生物群-神经炎症通路可能成为ALS非药物干预的靶点，值得关注其转化潜力。

aiRead.keyFinding: 运动诱导的肌因子（如鸢尾素、组织蛋白酶B、乳酸）与肠道微生物代谢物（如短链脂肪酸）相互作用，影响神经炎症和神经保护，可能调节ALS等疾病的进展。
aiRead.limitation: 叙述性综述，未进行系统检索或定量分析；证据主要来自动物和细胞研究，临床证据有限。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续关于运动干预对ALS患者肠道微生物群和神经炎症标志物影响的临床试验，以及肌因子作为生物标志物的研究。

items.abstractZh: 神经退行性疾病，如阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和肌萎缩侧索硬化，日益被认为是不仅受内在神经病理影响，还受全身生理网络（包括肠-脑轴）影响的疾病。新兴证据强调体力活动是这种双向通讯系统的强效调节剂，其中肌肉来源的信号，特别是肌因子、代谢物和细胞外囊泡，发挥着核心作用。这篇叙述性综述综合了关于运动诱导的分子介质如何影响肠道微生物群组成、肠道屏障完整性、免疫信号和神经炎症途径的当前知识。研究结果整合了神经科学、微生物学和运动生理学等学科，以评估肌肉分泌因子与肠道介导反应之间的机制联系。肌肉分泌因子（如鸢尾素、组织蛋白酶B、BDNF诱导途径和乳酸）与微生物代谢物（包括短链脂肪酸）之间存在机制联系。这些相互作用的途径显示出对神经保护、突触可塑性以及神经退行性疾病进展调节的综合影响。体力活动代表了一种有前景的非药物策略，用于调节神经退行性疾病中的肠-脑轴。理解肌肉来源信号与肠道介导途径之间的相互作用，可能为旨在减缓或预防神经退行性衰退的靶向干预开辟新途径。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述整合了2026年前后的最新证据，聚焦运动介导的肌因子与肠道微生物群在ALS等神经退行性疾病中的交互作用，具有转化价值。

items.title: Voice Disorders as Early Biomarkers of Cognitive Decline.
items.summary: Dementia affects greater than 57 million people worldwide. With an aging population and limited disease-curing treatments available, early identification of biomarkers is crucial. The 2020 Lancet Commission identified hearing loss as the largest modifiable risk factor for dementia globally, and a randomized controlled trial found that hearing intervention reduced 3-year cognitive change in older adults who were at increased risk for cognitive decline. Similarly, studies have found that abnormalities in acoustic measures of voice are correlated with cognitive status and can potentially predict decline. The association between hearing loss and cognitive decline might have both social and neurological mechanisms. Dysphonia might pose similar problems. Socially, voice disorders may reduce engagement in social and cognitively stimulating activities. Neurologically, one example is in Parkinson's disease in which the vagus nerve is one of the earliest sites of Lewy body pathology in Braak staging, and dysphonia and dysarthria can precede motor symptoms by years. Voice changes have been associated with different neurological conditions such as amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, multiple system atrophy, and Alzheimer's disease. Despite this, no prior large-scale study has examined whether diagnosed voice disorders are associated independently with incident cognitive decline. Our study is the first to examine this potential association, using the TriNetX US Collaborative Health Network platform to compare patients with diagnosed voice disorders and matched controls, with a hearing loss cohort as a standard of comparison given that it is the largest established modifiable risk factor for dementia, as dysphonia is also a modifiable condition. This study included 833,417 total patients in the voice disorders and control cohorts. Voice disorders were associated with a significantly elevated risk of incident cognitive decline compared to controls (HR=1.291, 95% CI 1.155-1.443, P<0.0001). Hearing loss alone was associated with a slightly lower risk of cognitive decline (HR=1.267, 95% CI 1.203-1.334, P<0.0001). Voice disorders without concurrent hearing loss were associated with an elevated risk of incident cognitive decline compared to hearing loss alone (HR=1.261, 95% CI 1.121-1.419, P=0.0001), while voice disorders with hearing loss were associated with the highest risk among all cohorts (HR=2.038 vs controls; HR=1.545 vs hearing loss). Both voice disorder subgroups did not differ when compared with each other (HR=1.088, P=0.376). The results from our study indicate that voice disorders are associated with an elevated risk of incident cognitive decline and may represent a stronger early biomarker than hearing loss alone. These findings highlight otolaryngology and family medicine/internal medicine encounters as potential entry points for cognitive assessment, and early voice treatment needs to be investigated for possible beneficial cognitive effect.

items.titleZh: 嗓音障碍作为认知衰退的早期生物标志物
items.summaryZh: 一项大规模回顾性队列研究（83万余人）发现，诊断为嗓音障碍的人后续发生认知衰退的风险显著升高（风险比约1.29），且与听力损失相比，嗓音障碍可能是一个更强的早期预警信号。嗓音障碍与听力损失同时存在时风险最高。该研究提示，嗓音变化可能作为神经退行性疾病的早期线索，值得在临床中关注。
items.insight: 这项研究首次在大规模人群中证实嗓音障碍与认知衰退独立相关，且风险高于听力损失，为ALS等神经退行性疾病的早期筛查提供了新的、可干预的切入点，可能推动嗓音评估纳入常规认知筛查。

aiRead.keyFinding: 嗓音障碍与偶发认知衰退风险升高独立相关（HR=1.291），且风险高于单独听力损失（HR=1.267）；两者并存时风险最高（HR=2.038）。
aiRead.limitation: 回顾性设计，依赖诊断编码，可能存在未测量的混杂因素；未区分嗓音障碍的具体病因；因果关系无法确定。

items.abstractZh: 痴呆影响全球超过5700万人。随着人口老龄化和可用的疾病治愈疗法有限，早期识别生物标志物至关重要。2020年柳叶刀委员会将听力损失确定为全球痴呆最大的可改变风险因素，一项随机对照试验发现，听力干预减少了认知衰退风险增加的老年人3年认知变化。类似地，研究发现嗓音声学测量的异常与认知状态相关，并可能预测衰退。听力损失与认知衰退之间的关联可能涉及社会性和神经性机制。嗓音障碍可能带来类似问题。在社会层面，嗓音障碍可能减少参与社交和认知刺激活动的机会。在神经层面，一个例子是帕金森病，其中迷走神经是Braak分期中路易体病理最早部位之一，嗓音障碍和构音障碍可能比运动症状早出现数年。嗓音变化已与多种神经疾病相关，如肌萎缩侧索硬化、多系统萎缩和阿尔茨海默病。尽管如此，此前尚无大规模研究检验诊断性嗓音障碍是否与偶发认知衰退独立相关。我们的研究首次使用TriNetX美国协作健康网络平台检验这一潜在关联，将诊断为嗓音障碍的患者与匹配对照进行比较，并以听力损失队列作为比较标准，因为听力损失是已确立的痴呆最大可改变风险因素，而嗓音障碍也是一种可改变状况。本研究共纳入833,417名患者（嗓音障碍组和对照组）。与对照组相比，嗓音障碍与偶发认知衰退风险显著升高相关（HR=1.291，95% CI 1.155-1.443，P<0.0001）。单独听力损失与认知衰退风险略低相关（HR=1.267，95% CI 1.203-1.334，P<0.0001）。无并发听力损失的嗓音障碍与单独听力损失相比，偶发认知衰退风险升高（HR=1.261，95% CI 1.121-1.419，P=0.0001），而嗓音障碍伴听力损失的队列风险最高（与对照组相比HR=2.038；与听力损失组相比HR=1.545）。两个嗓音障碍亚组之间无显著差异（HR=1.088，P=0.376）。我们的研究结果表明，嗓音障碍与偶发认知衰退风险升高相关，可能比单独听力损失更强的早期生物标志物。这些发现强调耳鼻喉科和家庭医学/内科就诊可作为认知评估的潜在切入点，早期嗓音治疗对认知的潜在有益效果需要进一步研究。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究利用2026年最新的大规模真实世界数据，首次将嗓音障碍确立为比听力损失更强的认知衰退早期生物标志物，具有直接的临床转化价值。

items.title: Association of Plasma Neurofilament Light Chain With Diagnostic Classification in a Neuromuscular Referral Cohort: A Cross-Sectional Study.
items.summary: Plasma neurofilament light chain (pNfL) is a blood-based biomarker of axonal injury elevated in several neuromuscular disorders. While previous studies have compared individual diseases with healthy controls, less is known about how pNfL performs across clinically relevant neuromuscular presentations encountered in subspecialty practice, particularly in distinguishing active from inactive neuropathies. We evaluated whether abnormal age-adjusted pNfL concentrations are associated with clinically relevant diagnostic categories and whether pNfL discriminates between active and inactive neuropathies. We conducted a cross-sectional study of patients evaluated by neuromuscular specialists at Mayo Clinic (Rochester, MN) between April 2022 and April 2024, in whom pNfL was ordered as part of routine clinical care. Diagnoses were assigned to prespecified categories by consensus review, including motor neuron disease (MND), active neuropathy, inactive neuropathy, and structural etiologies. Clinically active neuropathy was defined using prespecified, diagnosis-specific operational criteria incorporating treatment status, clinical relapse or progression, time from symptom onset, and pathologic evidence of inflammation. Abnormal pNfL was defined using previously established age-adjusted 97.5th percentile reference limits. Multinomial logistic regression evaluated associations between abnormal pNfL and diagnostic category, adjusting for neuropathy impairment score and symptom duration. Receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analyses assessed discrimination between prespecified groups. Among 306 patients (mean age 62.2 years, 41.5% female), 179 (58.5%) had MND, 28 (9.1%) active neuropathy, 75 (12.1%) inactive neuropathy, and 24 (7.8%) structural etiologies. Median pNfL concentrations differed across diagnostic groups ( p < 0.0001) and were highest in MND and active neuropathy. After adjustment, abnormal pNfL was associated with a higher relative likelihood of classification as MND (relative risk ratio [RRR] 18.47, 95% CI 8.77-38.86) and active neuropathy (RRR 7.30, 95% CI 2.50-21.34) compared with inactive neuropathies. No association was observed with structural etiologies. Discrimination between active and inactive neuropathy was moderate (area under the curve [AUC] 0.79, 95% CI 0.70-0.88), and discrimination for MND vs all other diagnoses was good (AUC 0.85, 95% CI 0.80-0.90). In this cross-sectional cohort, abnormal age-adjusted pNfL concentrations were more frequently observed in diagnostic categories characterized by clinically active axonal injury than in inactive neuropathies and structural conditions. These findings suggest a potential role for pNfL as an adjunctive tool in neuromuscular diagnostic evaluation. Interpretation is limited by the cross-sectional design and convenience sampling. This study provides Class II evidence that abnormal age-adjusted pNfL distinguishes active neuropathies from inactive neuropathies with moderate diagnostic accuracy.

items.titleZh: 血浆神经丝轻链与神经肌肉转诊队列中诊断分类的关联：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 这项来自梅奥诊所的横断面研究分析了306名神经肌肉转诊患者，发现血浆NfL水平在运动神经元病和活动性神经病变中显著升高，且异常pNfL与MND（相对风险比18.47）和活动性神经病变（相对风险比7.30）的诊断分类强相关，但与非活动性神经病变或结构性病因无关。pNfL区分活动性与非活动性神经病变的准确性中等（AUC 0.79），区分MND与其他诊断的准确性良好（AUC 0.85）。研究提示pNfL可作为神经肌肉疾病诊断评估的辅助工具，但需注意横断面设计和便利抽样的局限性。
items.insight: 这项研究为pNfL在神经肌肉疾病鉴别诊断中的价值提供了真实世界证据，特别是其区分活动性轴突损伤（如ALS）与非活动性病变的能力，对ALS早期诊断和疾病活动性监测具有重要参考意义。

aiRead.keyFinding: 年龄校正后异常pNfL在MND和活动性神经病变中显著升高，可中等准确区分活动性与非活动性神经病变（AUC 0.79），并良好区分MND与其他诊断（AUC 0.85）。
aiRead.limitation: 横断面设计无法推断因果关系；便利抽样可能引入选择偏倚；pNfL检测在临床实践中的使用可能受医生判断影响。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续应关注纵向研究验证pNfL在ALS疾病进展和疗效监测中的动态变化，以及与其他生物标志物（如UCHL1、tau）联合使用的诊断价值。

items.abstractZh: 血浆神经丝轻链（pNfL）是一种基于血液的轴突损伤生物标志物，在多种神经肌肉疾病中升高。虽然既往研究将个别疾病与健康对照进行比较，但关于pNfL在亚专科实践中遇到的临床相关神经肌肉表现中的表现，尤其是在区分活动性与非活动性神经病变方面的作用，知之甚少。我们评估了年龄校正后异常pNfL浓度是否与临床相关的诊断类别相关，以及pNfL是否能区分活动性和非活动性神经病变。我们于2022年4月至2024年4月在梅奥诊所（罗切斯特，明尼苏达州）对由神经肌肉专科医生评估的患者进行了一项横断面研究，这些患者在常规临床护理中接受了pNfL检测。通过共识审查将诊断分配到预设类别，包括运动神经元病（MND）、活动性神经病变、非活动性神经病变和结构性病因。临床活动性神经病变使用预设的、诊断特异性的操作标准定义，包括治疗状态、临床复发或进展、症状发作时间以及炎症的病理学证据。异常pNfL使用先前建立的年龄调整的97.5百分位参考限值定义。多项逻辑回归评估了异常pNfL与诊断类别之间的关联，调整了神经病变损伤评分和症状持续时间。接受者操作特征（ROC）分析评估了预设组之间的区分能力。在306名患者中（平均年龄62.2岁，41.5%为女性），179名（58.5%）患有MND，28名（9.1%）患有活动性神经病变，75名（12.1%）患有非活动性神经病变，24名（7.8%）患有结构性病因。pNfL中位数浓度在不同诊断组间存在差异（p < 0.0001），在MND和活动性神经病变中最高。调整后，与非活动性神经病变相比，异常pNfL与MND分类的相对可能性较高（相对风险比[RRR] 18.47，95% CI 8.77-38.86）和活动性神经病变（RRR 7.30，95% CI 2.50-21.34）相关。未观察到与结构性病因的关联。活动性与非活动性神经病变之间的区分能力中等（曲线下面积[AUC] 0.79，95% CI 0.70-0.88），MND与所有其他诊断的区分能力良好（AUC 0.85，95% CI 0.80-0.90）。在这项横断面队列中，年龄校正后异常pNfL浓度在临床活动性轴突损伤特征的诊断类别中比非活动性神经病变和结构性病变更常见。这些发现提示pNfL作为神经肌肉诊断评估辅助工具的潜在作用。解释受横断面设计和便利抽样限制。本研究提供了II级证据，表明年龄校正后异常pNfL以中等诊断准确性区分活动性神经病变与非活动性神经病变。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2022-2024年的大样本临床队列，直接评估pNfL在ALS等神经肌肉疾病中的诊断区分能力，具有高度的ALS相关性和近期临床转化价值。

items.summaryZh: 这项动物研究测试了口服二苯甲酰甲烷（DBM）对C9ORF72相关额颞叶痴呆（FTD）小鼠模型认知功能的影响。结果显示DBM能够预防该模型中的认知衰退。由于C9ORF72突变同时与ALS和FTD相关，该发现可能对ALS研究具有参考价值。
items.insight: C9ORF72六核苷酸重复扩增是ALS和FTD最常见的遗传病因之一。该研究探索了DBM这一小分子化合物在C9ORF72介导的FTD模型中的神经保护作用，为针对C9ORF72相关神经退行性疾病的干预策略提供了新的候选方向，值得ALS研究者关注。

items.titleZh: 谁的声音？算法平滑与脑机接口介导的临终请求的混合作者身份：一项规范性概念分析
items.summaryZh: 本文是一篇规范性概念分析，探讨在ALS等神经退行性疾病患者使用脑机接口（BCI）表达临终请求时，算法处理（“平滑”）如何影响请求的“作者身份”。核心问题是：当BCI系统通过算法优化或修正患者的神经信号输出时，最终表达的内容究竟属于患者本人，还是算法与患者的“混合产物”？该研究不涉及临床试验数据，而是从伦理和哲学层面分析BCI在临终决策中的适用性。
items.insight: 随着BCI技术从实验室走向临床，ALS患者可能越来越多地依赖该系统进行沟通，包括表达临终意愿。本文提出的“混合作者身份”概念，直接挑战了“患者自主意愿”在BCI场景下的纯粹性，对神经伦理学和ALS临终关怀实践具有前瞻性指导意义，值得关注BCI伦理与政策的研究者跟踪。

aiRead.studyType: 规范性概念分析（理论/伦理研究）
aiRead.keyFinding: 提出BCI介导的临终请求应被视为“混合作者身份”——即患者意图与算法平滑处理共同作用的结果，而非纯粹的患者自主表达。
aiRead.limitation: 作为概念分析，缺乏实证数据支持；未涉及具体BCI算法技术细节或临床案例验证。

items.insight: 该研究值得 ALS 研究者关注，因为它提出了一个此前未被明确描述的选择性肌肉受累模式。这种“外展肌保留”现象可能为 ALS 的神经退行性过程提供新的解剖学线索，并可能影响临床查体、肌电图评估以及疾病进展的监测策略。
